summary: Regression test for templates extraction refactor (Jan 2026 — ~640 lines moved from routes_extended.py to routes_templates_extended.py + 16 test records cleanup). Backend: 13/13 pytest assertions PASS. All moved endpoints respond on their original URL paths (GET /api/invoice-templates returns 200, POST /api/print/render renders placeholders correctly with Ahmed/1500, POST /api/templates accepted). Firewall status returns total_entries=63 and balance_health_percent=100.0 as expected. All extended endpoints not moved still respond 200 (operations/pending, operations, biz-accounts, accounts, accounts/tree, vehicles, finance/reports/trial-balance). Double-entry firewall still rejects unbalanced 100/50 entries with 400 and lifetime_rejections counter increments. Frontend: /accounting/firewall renders all stat cards including firewall-stat-health (100%, 63/63) and firewall-stat-rejections (1). /accounting/journal-entries loads with 0 JS errors. Sidebar link '🛡️ جدار حماية المحاسبة' is present and visible. NO REGRESSIONS DETECTED — refactor is safe.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_templates_extended.py (670 lines) — clean extraction; both modules expose `router` and `set_db` symmetrically (good).

Potential URL conflict noted: /api/templates exists in BOTH routes_templates.py and routes_templates_extended.py. routes_templates.py wins by FastAPI include order, which matches the documented intent. Consider adding a comment in routes_templates_extended.py near the @router.get('/templates') decorator to record this so future devs do not accidentally remove the routes_templates.py duplicate.
firewall_state is still in-memory only (counters reset on backend restart) — existing observation from iter 190; not affected by this refactor.

Pre-existing 500s on /api/coa/tree and /api/print/resolve-template (when db is None) were NOT exercised in this regression run since DB_PROVIDER=supabase is active and supabase client is bound; they are documented as pre-existing in the request context.
